pr_title: Disable deprecation log indexing until templates are loaded
pr_body:
Deprecation log indexing relies on index templates to be present in
cluster state in order to create a data stream.
If a very early deprecation is emitted after node is started up and
templates are not loaded yet this can result in regular index with
default settings and mappings to be created.
To prevent this a bulk processor used for indexing deprecation logs
delays flushing until templates are loaded.

closes #80265

issue_context.title: Deprecation log datastream is missing settings after upgrade
comments:
Thanks for raising this @pgomulka. I can add two additional bits of information we were able to find with @pebrc:
1. Version `6.8.17` is not special here, I was able to repro when upgrading from `7.15.0`
2. It feels like a race condition - we see some correlation to `Xm[sx]`. The less memory ES has the less likely it is for the issue to occur. I was not able to repro using containers with 1 GiB of memory, but I was able to repro with 2 and 4 GiBs.

we found out that there was a possibility of a race condition where a deprecation was emitted before the templates and ilm policy was loaded.
It was the Security deprecation that was causing this in the docker example

review_comments: I think we can remove the `JsonNode ` usage here as well? And use `XContentMapValues `?
